messages:
incident-bot: PAGER TRIGGERED -> Severity: P1. Dedicated inference cluster (eu-west-2-dedicated-42) exceeded error-rate threshold for account AlderBio. Paging on-call: @maya. Link: https://infra.redwood/status/2165432100-runbook (runbook: dedicated/outage)

maya: acked. looking now. can someone confirm impact surface?

jamal: seeing sustained 502s and grpc timeouts from the dedicated pool serving AlderBio production model. 5xx rate ~85% on their route over the last 3m. traces show kv-cache miss + gpt-attn kernel OOMs on 1 of 6 hosts. logs: `worker-42` failing with `OSError: CUDAMemoryError` then 502 gateway.

maya: thanks. is this isolated to AlderBio or affecting other tenants on that pool?

jamal: isolated to AlderBio's routing tag (customer_id: alderbio-prod). Other tenants on pool are low traffic right now, not spiking errors. seems model variant + sequence length combo causing OOM.

priya: jumping in — likely regression from yesterday's kernel change plus AlderBio's long prompt distribution. I'll triage model->kernel selection and try rolling back kernel selection on those hosts.

erin: FYI I've started the account notify path. Need a short tailored impact statement we can send to AlderBio execs and also publish to status. They want channel-specific comms (email + phone).

leo: have the AlderBio contact list handy: 
- Primary: ops@alderbio.com, +1-415-555-0198 (S. Park, Ops Lead)
- Escalation: andrea.martin@alderbio.com, +44 20 7946 0300 (VP Eng)
- Legal contact: compliance@alderbio.com
- Pager alternative: +1-415-555-0123 (on-call team)
(From last enterprise onboarding doc)

maya: perfect. erin, can you draft the email? small, factual, non-technical impact line + mitigation plan + ETA. We'll also post status page.

erin: draft below — please review/approve. short version for execs and an ops-level blurb.

--- EMAIL DRAFT BEGIN ---
Subject: Incident: AlderBio production inference errors (investigating)

Hi Andrea / AlderBio ops team,

We’re investigating an issue affecting inference requests for your production workspace (AlderBio - prod) in eu-west-2. Some requests are failing with 502 errors; this started at ~2026-03-15T10:01:40Z. We understand this may impact your UI and API calls.

What we know:
- Scope: All inference requests routed to your dedicated pool (eu-west-2-dedicated-42).
- Impact: ~85% of requests returning 502/timeout for some models; short requests may succeed intermittently.
- Customer visible effect: failed generations, intermittent latency spikes.

What we’re doing:
- Deploying fallback routing to our hosted pool for new requests to reduce errors (temporary).
- Rolling back a kernel selection change on affected hosts and restarting workers.
- Eng on-call (Redwood) and AlderBio support are coordinating.

ETA and next steps:
- Temporary fallback routing expected within 7–10 minutes.
- Further updates within 15 minutes or as significant changes occur.

Contact: Erin (Account) — erin@redwood.ai, +1-650-555-0130.

We’ll follow up with a post-incident summary once resolved.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Incident Response
--- EMAIL DRAFT END ---

priya: looks good. add that we will not change user data and no config changes to customer workspace are needed.

erin: updated. finalizing send-ready copy.

jamal: operational notes — applying temporary routing now: `rdw route apply --account alderbio --from eu-west-2-dedicated-42 --to hosted-eu-standard-1 --strategy gradual --drain 30s`

maya: please run that command and post result. also update status page snippet.

jamal: ran route command, initial metrics show error-rate dropping to 12% on the routed requests. Some remainders still hitting old hosts due to long-lived connections; we’re forcing connection drain.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: human on-call acknowledged @maya at 10:03:12Z. Pager follow-ups suppressed.

zoe: status page proposal (short):
- Component: Dedicated Inference (eu-west-2, pool 42)
- Status: Major outage — Partial service disruption for AlderBio production requests.
- Update: We are routing new requests to a hosted fallback and investigating kernel regressions. Estimated mitigation within 15 minutes.

(Full update will follow.)

maya: +1 post that and tag enterprise-notify channel. erin send the exec email now once I confirm error-rate stable.

erin: sending email to primary + escalation now. cc: legal & account team.

leo: I posted a tailored note in the AlderBio shared channel and pinged S. Park with the email and phone.

jamal: kernel rollback in progress on 3/6 affected hosts. worker restarts happening in a rolling fashion to avoid mass reconnects.

maya: monitoring. error-rate trending down. current 502 rate for AlderBio aggregate: 6% (was 85%).

priya: I’ll stay on this until kernel change validated. if rollback doesn’t hold we’ll switch to forced model-shard placement and reduce max_seq_len to avoid OOM.

maya: decision log: 
- Route new requests to hosted fallback (temporary).
- Rollback kernel selection on affected hosts.
- Notify AlderBio ops + execs (email + phone).
- Update status page to Major outage and provide ETA.

zoe: internal comms template for CS/Sales to reuse: 
"Redwood Internal: AlderBio is experiencing partial outage for production inference in eu-west-2. New requests are being routed to hosted fallback. Eng is rolling back a recent kernel change; ETA 15m. Contact Erin (erin@redwood.ai) or Maya (pager) for updates. Do not escalate via public channels; use enterprise-notify."

erin: confirmation from AlderBio ops: they received the email and on-call confirmed they can tolerate temporary fallback but request continuous updates.

jamal: final operational note: kernel rollback completed on all affected hosts at 10:12:30Z. residual client connections cleared. No data loss.

maya: marking this thread as CONTAINED. will keep monitoring for 1h then hand to postmortem. pls hold any external comms until final status update.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE POSTED -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2165432100 (Major outage -> contained).

maya: handing off to zoe and erin for customer wrap and postmortem creation. tagging @priya and @jamal for follow-up.

zoe: noted. I'll draft the customer follow-up and postmortem template with timelines + root cause. ETA for RAID doc: 2 business days.

erin: thanks all. closing the live page for now; will send a follow-up to AlderBio with timeline and remediation steps.

maya: thanks team. great coordinated run. :thumbsup:
